checks.name: full_current_regression
checks.result: All 17 gates of regression contract 1.1.0 passed on a clean, unchanged source commit. Every workspace member and all targets were built and exercised; all 273 Rust unit/integration functions and two doctests passed.
criteria: 覆盖关键正常、边界、异常、恢复路径，缺陷以可复用根因修复并补同类回归。
完整 regression 报告绑定源码 SHA，不以组件通过声明真实 E4 完成。

checks.name: all_specialist_conditions
checks.result: All 122 namespaced conditions passed under current contracts: paths 26, payloads 32 at version 1.4.0, mutation recovery 20, concurrency 20 and database recovery 24. Transitive receipts and raw log hashes were verified; repeated Rust executions do not add to the 273 workspace functions.

checks.name: ignored_entrypoints_and_transports
checks.result: All four ignored entries match the current inventory and have executed parent/specialist routes, including explicit crash-to-CLI recovery. All eight CLI/MCP parity tests and tools passed, alongside legacy YAML intake, dangling-state diagnosis, the complete copied manual lifecycle and four developer examples.

checks.name: reusable_fixes_and_red_baselines
checks.result: Retained the first 15/17 full-suite report, two failing Basic unit baselines, an intermediate failing cache-upgrade test and the old example assertion. Fixed the shared detection policy, short credentials, derived-cache invalidation and the example domain-error assertion. Three new regression functions and related source/event/evidence/search/context checks passed.

checks.name: source_receipt_binding
checks.result: Execution is bound to source 9bfdf8885209810fb172ccfc6753fd1ef2a7f317, its Git/GitHub receipt, tracked input manifest and built binary hashes. Subsequent developer-use metadata updates are listed explicitly; all 392 other tested input files remain identical. This report does not claim to have run on a future evidence commit.

checks.name: actual_project_use
checks.result: On the actual project, Doctor preserved the schema, all 25 tables, revision and source fingerprint. MCP observation/progress writes retained session/claim ownership; exact source changes, recovery snapshots and attempt receipts matched. Context is complete at 4992 tokens; only the intentionally active session remains in Doctor.

checks.name: reviewed_scope_and_counting
checks.result: Reviewed all-target and doctest coverage, ignored-test routes, fixture roots, source/binary hashes, transitive receipt validation, Basic decoding and cache upgrade behavior. No business scenarios, platform gates, metrics or release completion are credited by local regression.

acceptance.criterion: 覆盖关键正常、边界、异常、恢复路径，缺陷以可复用根因修复并补同类回归。
完整 regression 报告绑定源码 SHA，不以组件通过声明真实 E4 完成。

limitations: This gate establishes local regression only. Other operating systems, performance metrics, native agent clients, eight E4 business scenarios and release readiness have their own ledger items.

All Cargo examples are compiled. Four isolated developer entrypoints, YAML intake and the manual lifecycle are executed; other historical examples receive compile coverage and their corresponding current CLI/domain tests.
The current execution used macOS arm64 and Rust 1.93.1. Native client activation and independent business review remain separate work.
Failure baselines retain their own source/working-tree boundaries. Only the complete new run supplies the current regression pass.
Raw logs and the full input-hash manifest are retained locally; public summaries bind their paths and hashes.
